src: two-color motif s outside the marked rectangle
dst: interior d of the rectangle whose corners are marker pixels and whose side bars have the motif colors
match_cond: s.left_edge_color == d.left_side_color and s.right_edge_color == d.right_side_color after optional horizontal reflection
transform: crop the marked rectangle; copy s into d, mirroring s horizontally first if its side colors are reversed
grid_shape: bbox of the four marker pixels
